statement_html:
Desenvolupar i reduir l'expressió \(\left(11 + 10 b\right) \left(7 b - 12\right)\).
La teua resposta :
\(\left(11 + 10 b\right) \left(7 b - 12\right) =\) .
solution_html:
\(({\color{red}} 11 {\color{purple}} + 10 b {\color{black}})({\color{blue}} 7 b {\color{green}} -12 {\color{black}} )\) = \({\color{red}}\char40 11 \char41{\color{black}}\times {\color{blue}}\char40 7 b \char41{\color{black}}\) + \({\color{red}}\char40 11 \char41{\color{black}} \times {\color{green}}\char40 -12 \char41{\color{black}}\) + \({\color{purple}}\char40 10 b \char41{\color{black}} \times {\color{blue}}\char40 7 b \char41{\color{black}}\) + \({\color{purple}}\char40 10 b \char41{\color{black}} \times {\color{green}}\char40 -12 \char41{\color{black}}\)
= \(77 b\) + \(\left(-132\right)\) + \(70 b^{2}\) + \(\left(- 120 b\right)\)
= \(70 b^{2} - 43 b - 132\)
